annotations: R Street and 1st Street NW, 24 ways (Q Street looked at, unchanged). The Q and R Street NW bike-lane corridors and 1st Street NW were rated above what the owner rides them at, and routes left them for busier streets and harder junctions (a westbound trip from 1st St NW took Randolph Pl and a left onto six-lane Florida Ave to avoid R St's LTS 4 block; at stress 90 a westbound R St trip left R at 9th St for S St to avoid its LTS 2.5 blocks). Three adjustments: R St's painted-lane blocks at LTS 2.5 go to the formula's LTS 2; R St's unpainted blocks where DDOT 2020 is above the formula (Georgetown, 28th St to Wisconsin Ave; North Capitol St to Florida Ave) go to LTS 2.5; 1st St NW's unpainted blocks where DDOT 2020 is above the formula, from E St to Channing St (except L St to New York Ave, below), go to LTS 2.5. Left as they are: Q St west of Dupont Circle (no lane, AADT 8,485, DDOT and formula both LTS 3); Q St 18th St to New Hampshire Ave (34 m, three lanes with a turn pocket, DDOT LTS 4, now LTS 2.5); 1st St NW at Peace Monument Circle to Constitution Ave and Hospital Center Dr to Irving St (four to six lanes, formula LTS 3); 1st St NW L St to New York Ave, way 466352082 (DDOT LTS 4, formula LTS 3, three lanes at New York Ave), left at LTS 4 for the city-wide review rather than lowered below the formula's own rating.
